why: lychee has no essential oil. Rose with a drop of bright grapefruit (steam-distilled) gives the juicy, rosy lychee effect; a lychee fragrance oil gives the real thing.
bitter almond oil can release cyanide unless it's the FFPA type, so Safe Batch leaves it out. Vanilla with creamy sandalwood gives a soft, nutty warmth in its place.

cherry's scent is mostly benzaldehyde, the marzipan-almond note. Bitter almond oil can release cyanide unless it is sold as FFPA, so Safe Batch leaves it out. Sweet orange gives a juicy fruit opening in its place; for true cherry, add a skin-safe cherry fragrance oil.
a creamy white flower like gardenia or tuberose. Jasmine with a touch of ylang is the natural version.

caramel milk|milk caramel|dulce de leche|milky caramel

why: creamy caramel. Extra vanilla gives the sweetness and sandalwood the milky softness; a caramel fragrance oil gives the burnt-sugar edge.
burnt-sugar sweetness has no essential oil. More vanilla is the closest; a skin-safe caramel fragrance oil gives the real thing.
a milky, creamy softness. Sandalwood is the classic natural way to get it.
warm, sweet resin. Vanilla is the closest natural stand-in; add a drop of frankincense for an amber feel.
real oud is rare and costly. Vetiver with a touch of patchouli gives a smoky, dark wood; for the real thing, make an agarwood chip tincture (see Recipes).
a soft dry wood. Cedarwood or sandalwood covers it.
a heady white flower. Jasmine with a touch of ylang is the natural version.
saffron oil is rarely sold for skin. A drop of cardamom with leather-like vetiver hints at it.
powdery orris is very costly. Carrot seed gives a similar earthy-powdery note in tiny amounts.
musk has no affordable natural oil. Skip it, or use a skin-safe musk fragrance oil; sandalwood adds a similar soft skin-like base.
leather is a fragrance-oil note. Smoky vetiver with birch-free cedar gives a hint.
fruit notes come from fragrance oils, not essential oils.
this note has no natural oil. Use a skin-safe fragrance oil from a soap supplier, or leave it out.
